Partial matches: a search of several words also lists names that hold only some of them, lower in the list. "ring mana" lists the Mana rings first, then other rings.
Exact match: a checkbox in the search box (Ctrl+E, or Y on a controller) lists only names that hold your whole text. Find remembers it, and the message line says how many results it hides. Rebind it with exact_key in find.ini.
One click on a line in the list finds it. Tab, the arrow keys and Enter work as before.
Chests and people show through walls in their real shape instead of a flat outline.
The World Map's Find box (The Worst Map Mod 1.3.49) gets the Exact match checkbox too.
Find keeps working when other mods (such as EML Tweaks) shift the game's internal numbering.
Fixed:
Chests sometimes didn't light up after a search.
Highlights shook and slid, with doubles snapping back into place.
Some recipes you had unlocked showed as "not unlocked yet", such as Coconut Milk.
On screens taller than 16:9 (such as 2560x1600), clicks in the search box landed below the line you pointed at.
